description.en: Income support to eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to scheme exclusions and verification.

eligibility_rules.note: Exclusion categories include specified constitutional/public office holders, government employees (with stated class exceptions), certain pensioners, income-tax payers and practising professionals.

application.channel: PM-KISAN official portal / designated state agriculture authorities
application.instructions: Use the official portal for registration/status and state verification. Do not treat land ownership alone as final approval.

grievance.instructions: Register complaints through the PM-KISAN grievance portal. For unresolved issues, use CPGRAMS or contact the local agriculture department. Keep the registration number for tracking.

sources.title: Revised PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines
sources.publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.supports: Landholding farmer family definition, annual support, exclusion categories

sources.title: PM-KISAN official scheme overview
sources.publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.supports: ₹6,000 yearly in three equal instalments; exclusions

verification.warning: A scheme-level status does not establish an individual's eligibility. Confirm the current state/UT implementation and official beneficiary record.

notes: Farmer family is defined in the guidelines as husband, wife and minor children owning cultivable land as per state/UT land records.
A person may appear to meet the broad definition but still be excluded; evaluate every exclusion category.
The operational guidelines source is dated; check later amendments before deploying exclusions as current rules.
